Allows you to set the number of loops as follows:

- `null` (or omitting in the CLI) plays the GIF indefinitely.
- `0` disables looping
- `1` loops the GIF once (plays twice in total)
- `2` loops the GIF twice (plays three times in total) and so on.

## CLI flag

```text
--number-of-gif-loops <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#numberofgifloops)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#numberofgifloops)
- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#numberofgifloops)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#numberofgifloops)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#numberofgifloops)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setNumberOfGifLoops(2);
```
